The '''Dutan nest''' was an [[Arcona/Legends|Arconan]] family nest. The entire nest was active in the arms trade; [[Dutan Lee]] exported arms using [[Dutan Mining Supply Exports]] as a front, while [[Dutan Kelliv]] supplied shipping schedules and security procedures from their position working at [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub's]] munitions factory in [[Gallisport]]. Unfortunately for the Dutan nest, several of their deals failed and funds went missing due to [[Dutana Leara]], a [[Salt/Legends|salt]] addict who talked too much when under the influence.
